CardDescription.DefaultText: The bones fall in two piles, one pointing at the sky and one at your stores. Within a day of this casting the eagle and the black bear are both hungry again. From then on, whenever you are outside, the eagle may take game left lying on open ground, and, while autumn lasts, the bear may raid the food kept in your containers and stores.

ActionDescription.DefaultText: Pick the bones up and put them away.
